synopsis: IEC TS 62998-1 is described as a newer specification for safety-related sensors that protect people but fall outside classic ESPE categories, including sensors used on mobile machines and outdoors [f12391]. Chapter 1 identifies Inxpect as using it for safety radar in mobile outdoor applications, specifically to analyse its second-generation radar [f439, f674]. Both Chapter 1 and the glossary explicitly label this use as a vendor claim, rather than independently established validation [f1045, f15279, f12394]. The glossary repeats the radar-use claim without naming the sensor maker; the supplied facts provide no quantitative results or independent confirmation of the claimed analysis [f12394, f674, f1045].
